name: Tappoos Group of Companies (Tappoo Pte Limited)
note: Family-owned Fijian group founded in 1941 by Tappoo Kanji (per Fiji Rugby's sponsor profile); retail, wholesale, manufacturing, travel, hospitality and real estate. Fiji Rugby's February 2025 announcement names the contracting entity Tappoo Pte Limited and makes it the official distribution partner and an official sponsor of the Fiji Rugby Union for four years. Root of the chain.
